svg.title: Gear ratios reduce the driven gear's motion
svg.desc: Two gear pairs with the same tooth spacing. On the left, an 8-tooth drive gear meshes with a 16-tooth driven gear: a 2:1 ratio. One clockwise turn of the drive gear produces half a counterclockwise turn of the driven gear. On the right, an 8-tooth drive gear meshes with a 30-tooth driven gear: a 3.75:1 ratio. One clockwise turn of the drive gear produces 4/15 of a counterclockwise turn of the driven gear. The outlines have exactly the labeled number of teeth.

g.text: Same input turn. More driven teeth → less output motion.
